supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not establish that PowerShell ran on WS-DREYES-01 around 13:40 UTC. The nearby recorded endpoint process events instead show SearchProtocolHost at 14:15 and conhost at 14:18; neither identifies PowerShell or explains the reported window.

At 13:32 UTC, paul.becker authenticated from WS-DREYES-01 to WS-PBECKER-01: the domain controller records tickets for paul.becker from 10.52.10.21, and WS-PBECKER-01 records a network logon with workstation WS-DREYES-01. This is inconsistent with the inventory practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-PBECKER-01, but the records do not show that this logon launched PowerShell or caused the reported window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence contains no PowerShell process-creation, script-block, or transcription record for the reported time; the nearby process records shown are for other executables (T114-00461, T114-00462, T114-00471, T114-00472).

Proxy and network records describe connections and web requests, not which local process created them; for example, the 13:40 records show browser-style requests but do not identify the process responsible (T114-00139, T114-00149, T114-00153).
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-DREYES-01 at approximately 13:40 UTC, and if so, its command line, parent process, user, and integrity level.
Whether the paul.becker authentication from WS-DREYES-01 was authorized, and whether it was related to the reported window.
Whether the reported window was a PowerShell console, another console-hosted application, or a benign transient window.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect endpoint EDR or process-audit telemetry for WS-DREYES-01 covering the alert time, including process tree, command line, user, and termination details.
Collect PowerShell Operational logs, script-block/transcription logs, and any available console or command history for WS-DREYES-01 around 13:40 UTC.
Validate with paul.becker and change/patch records whether the 13:32 authentication from WS-DREYES-01 was expected; if available, correlate it with remote-session and file-share access logs.
unrelated_findings: Domain-controller credential-validation records name WS-KNGUYEN-01 for dan.reyes at 13:40 and WS-SALI-01 at 13:45. These records do not establish success or link those events to the reported PowerShell window; review them separately (T114-00140, T114-00333).
